payout_value_note: Flat $25 to the referrer and $25 to the new member. No limit on eligible referrals.
payout_quote: When they open a qualifying account or loan and meet a few requirements, you'll both earn $25. ... There's no limit to the number of eligible friends and family members you can refer.
steps: Member logs into Mobile or Online Banking, goes to Menu > Special Offers, and shares their personal referral code by text, email, or social media.

New member (18+, not a signer on a Mission Fed account in the last 12 months) opens a qualifying product with the referral code: a Spending/Checking account, a credit card, or an auto/personal/mortgage/home equity loan.

Within 90 days the new member fully satisfies one option: A) checking/spending with 5 eligible member-initiated transactions; B) new credit card + 5 purchase transactions or 1 balance transfer; C) approved loan funded + deposit account opened and funded.
Referral code must be provided within 30 days of account opening; loans must fund within 90 days.
$25 deposited to both accounts on approximately the 91st day of the new member's account opening.
catches: No limit on referrals — but only $25 each.
New member must fully satisfy Option A, B, or C within 90 days; partial completion disqualifies.
Limit one referral bonus per new member account opening.
Employees referring other Mission Fed employees do not qualify.
Accounts must be in good standing; recipients responsible for taxes.
biggest_catch: Only $25 each, the offer ends September 30, 2026, and the $25 isn't deposited until roughly day 91.
eligibility: Mission Fed membership (San Diego area); new member 18+ with no Mission Fed account in the last 12 months.
timing: Code sharing ~5 min active; $25 deposited ~91 days after the new member's account opening.
